scenario: A portfolio manager fetches real-time prices for a set of equity holdings, constructs a portfolio snapshot in the RiskOfficer platform to compute Value-at-Risk, and then generates a formal daily risk report summarizing portfolio exposure for senior management.
info_flow: stock-prices fetches current market prices for each holding → riskofficer uses those prices to construct a portfolio snapshot and calculate VaR/CVaR/Sharpe metrics → reporting produces a structured daily risk report from those metrics.
